note: Answer key for the two refute-claims controls. The workflow script NEVER reads this file and no skeptic is given its path; tests/meta-week/refute-claims.test.ts carries the same map and fails if the two disagree. Claim ids are opaque (c01..c17) precisely so that nothing a skeptic sees encodes the expected verdict. c03 is tagged kind=behavior in both packages, so its only possible verdicts are refuted and untested — a document cannot confirm what the system does.
passExpectation: 16 verdicts: 9 confirmed, 6 refuted, 0 unclear, 1 untested (c03, the behaviour claim). 2 or more of the expected-confirmed claims refuted means the round is a false-positive generator and does not ship; so does any verdict but untested for c03.
failExpectation: 17 verdicts: c17 refuted, and every other verdict identical to the PASS run. The delta is the signal.
